maria: Quick follow-up from the PM: recurring pattern = cloud transient -> auth token surge -> model-registry timeouts -> short client errors. We need a single tracker, owners, and a monthly check-in. Who can take point? :mag:
aj: I can own the tracker and rotate owners monthly. Will make a sheet with owner, status, priority, SLA mapping. Can someone export 90d vendor-filtered incidents? :white_check_mark:
liam: I'll grab the logs and make a vendor-week heatmap (include deploy markers). ETA EOD.
sre_lead: Please also audit circuit-breakers and autoscaler backoff. Our retries might be worsening blips. Add "failure mode" and "short-term mitigation" to the tracker.
kate: I'll reconcile runbooks with observed failures and propose quick runbook patches (token jitter handling, cross-region retry logic). Target Tue AM.
security: I'll review KMS/token rotation timing. If rotations are simultaneous, propose staggering and jitter. Report by Mon.
aj: Actions (claim with :white_check_mark:):
- AJ: remediation tracker (sheet + owner tags) 126-04-15
- LIAM: heatmap + 90d extracts 126-04-13
- KATE: runbook gaps + patches 126-04-14
- SECURITY: rotation + jitter proposal 126-04-13
- SRE_LEAD: CB & autoscaler review 126-04-16
I'll post the sheet link when ready.
oncall-bot: Linked Incident INC-2026-0413-07 126-created tracker DEC-2026-0413-01 assigned AJ.
maria: Thanks. Two asks before close: add postmortem link to the tracker and mark infra fallback work as blocker. Scheduling Wed 09:00 sync to review heatmap + tracker. Leaving thread open for updates through Monday. Tag @maria or @aj if blocked. :calendar:
